messages:
rachel: Quick notenoticed a pattern in invoice-preview: small tenants showing transient token lines tied to the wrong route after the priority-router switch.
omar: Same, saw a few examples. Can you paste one?
rachel: minimal trace (ids redacted):
```
2026-07-14T16:42:01.100Z INFO request=R-900 router=priority-fast decision=optimistic
2026-07-14T16:42:01.101Z DEBUG enrichment=start request=R-900
2026-07-14T16:42:01.102Z INFO router=fallback route=stable-eu request=R-900
2026-07-14T16:42:01.103Z INFO meter=emit tenant=null tokens=17 request=R-900
2026-07-14T16:42:01.105Z INFO enrichment=complete tenant=org-small request=R-900
2026-07-14T16:42:01.106Z INFO billing-ingest tenant=org-small request=R-900
```
jin: meter emitted before enrichment finished, so preview shows a short-lived spike on stable-eu. Reconciler fixes it later but preview isn't folding corrections immediately.
patrick: Stalling the emit until enrichment is robust would hurt p50 on priority lanes. What about emitting a minimal provisional event with an attribution_key and a "draft" flag, then reconciling?
omar: Draft approach seems least latency-invasive. Key details: 1) attribution_key deterministic (sha256(reqid+session+edge_ts)), 2) provisional=true on initial emit, 3) reconciler emits correction events {attribution_key, tokens_delta, final=true}.
jin: Preview service must consume correction events and apply them atomically to the in-memory aggregates; otherwise UI will show duplicates. Also add an event_seq for ordering.
billing-bot: ALERT: invoice-preview-delta monitor fired for 4 tenants in eu-west at 16:43 UTC.
rachel: UX: show a subtle "Draft" badge for provisional lines with hover text: "This line is provisional and may be reconciled within ~60s." Keep draft rows excluded from default CSV export. Add an opt-in flag for customers wanting live drafts.
patrick: Operational controls: feature-flag at router to enable provisional emits; start shadow at 1% traffic for 48h, then 5% for 72h. Rollback if any tenant sees >0.1% delta or >2 support tickets in 24h. Ticket INF-9612 created.
omar: Metrics to add: provisional_emits_total, provisional_reconciled_total, draft_doublecount_rate, enrich_latency_p99. Alert if draft_doublecount_rate > 0.2% for any tenant-day.
jin: Implementation owners: meter+schema=omar, reconciler=j in, preview-ui=patrick, rollout=rachel. I'll add unit tests for idempotent corrections and ordering.
rachel: Also pin a short-lived orphan ledger namespace for provisional tokens so accounting queries aren't confusing while drafts exist. Reconciler will move amounts atomically from orphan -> tenant ledger on finalize.
patrick: Agree. Let's keep the canary small and monitor the draft metrics closely. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
